name: Gatekeeper reveals she IS the decision maker
description: CRITICAL: Prospect initially seems like gatekeeper but then says 'I'm actually the office manager'. Coach must switch to DM phase and stop suggesting gatekeeper plays.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Unknown — probably receptionist

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Bright Smiles Dental, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey — quick one. When your front desk is busy, do calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Voicemail usually. But I'm actually the office manager here — I handle everything.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: CRITICAL: She just revealed she IS the DM. Must switch to DM phase. Suggest DM diagnostic plays (13, 14, 16, 19, 20) — not gatekeeper plays. Her 'I handle everything' may also signal chaos thread.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Oh you handle everything? That's a lot on one person.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah, it's been crazy. We lost a girl two weeks ago and I've been doing it all since.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: People thread or chaos thread. She's venting about being short-staffed. DM plays only.
